searchText: for cryptographers, fyi Hashing to Elliptic Curves draft 8 is seeking feedback https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-irtf-cfrg-hash-to-curve/ And note that the changes made don't affect how we use hash to curve. A sanity conf on that from any readers of the spec is welcome is there a timeline on when we can expect it to be finalized ? We and a number of chains are going with draft 7 (or any updates that are not substantive wrt our use case) unless critical vulnerabilities are found The actual ietf process takes a long time. Could expect it to be officially finalized next year.. gotcha, thanks for clarifying. Yeah I dont think most people are going to wait for it to finalize then lol. Just stumbled upon that https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-metrics/blob/master/metrics.md , it's referenced from the eth2.0-specs but no update since 2019, I find it a bit odd, is this repo up to date ? > And note that the changes made don't affect how we use hash to curve. A sanity conf on that from any readers of the spec is welcome I've run the v08 test vectors against my v07 implementation and all looks fine. By and large the changes are cosmetic/editorial, looking at the diff. Thanks Ben! <@!415109946682769408> can also confirm test vectors are good on py_ecc side Unless I get some pushback from client teams, I'm finishing https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/1861 today and releasing as a v0.12.1. It is breaking, but _not_ breaking wrt to any public nets. I'd rather keep it under v0.12, but we can discuss it more if you want thats fine for us <@!291925846556540928> we only have a private v0.12 testnet for now, so nothing would break Fine with Teku - v12 is still wip, so no problem.

excerpts.content: is there a timeline on when we can expect it to be finalized ?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
We and a number of chains are going with draft 7 (or any updates that are not substantive wrt our use case) unless critical vulnerabilities are found

The actual ietf process takes a long time. Could expect it to be officially finalized next year..

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: gotcha, thanks for clarifying. Yeah I dont think most people are going to wait for it to finalize then lol.

excerpts.content: Just stumbled upon that https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-metrics/blob/master/metrics.md , it's referenced from the eth2.0-specs but no update since 2019,  I find it a bit odd, is this repo up to date ?

excerpts.author: benjaminion
excerpts.content:
> And note that the changes made don't affect how we use hash to curve. A sanity conf on that from any readers of the spec is welcome
I've run the v08 test vectors against my v07 implementation and all looks fine. By and large the changes are cosmetic/editorial, looking at the diff.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: Thanks Ben! <@!415109946682769408> can also confirm test vectors are good on py_ecc side

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
Unless I get some pushback from client teams, I'm finishing https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/1861 today and releasing as a v0.12.1. 
It is breaking, but _not_ breaking wrt to any public nets. I'd rather keep it under v0.12, but we can discuss it more if you want
